title: 墨潮 / INK TIDE

production.direction: Lyrical acoustic film score with a developed final climax

climax.pianoFinalResponse: Explicit rests; does not reuse the first-theme reply

pianoSamples.author: Alexander Holm
pianoSamples.processing: 原AB录音左麦克风声道；近邻音高变速；每采样音高一份录音，非完整16力度层。

acousticSamples.processing: Left recording microphone, silence trimming with onset margin, 44.1 kHz mono MP3; source amplitude unchanged. Scientific MIDI mapping verified against original SFZ. One recording per key; no velocity switching, round robin, legato or sustain loop. Bounded 0.5–2 sustain gain compensation plus project mix gain applied during playback.

climaxComparison.method: Compare PCM16 WAV at identical beat windows, before FFmpeg LUFS mastering
climaxComparison.note: Energy measurements do not establish musical beauty, excitement or perceived balance.

mastering.method: FFmpeg loudnorm / EBU R128, measured from source and decoded final files
mastering.targetNote: Project production target; no platform loudness standard is claimed. MP3 encoding can alter measured loudness/true peak.

climaxPreview.includes: final section last ten bars, two-bar outro and original tail
climaxPreview.processing: Trim original WAV at exact sample frame, 20 ms entry fade, independent two-pass MP3 loudness mastering

browserRegression.command: npm run test:browser, then failed legacy target rerun and remaining targets individually
passedTargets: ink-tide PCM, samples, parameter limits and player
browserRegression.note: The unchanged Mountains Awake target failed its original strict maximum threshold both in the suite and one isolated retry. This failure pattern was also recorded in v5. No legacy voice or tolerance was changed. Ink Tide targets passed; do not describe the whole suite as passing.

rawStems.processing: Original track gain, pan, filters, linear sends, automation and kick-driven bass ducking. No per-stem normalization, DC removal or edge fades.
rawStems.note: Full-score stems at original gain, including the developed climax. All WAV align at time zero. No per-stem normalization or final DC/edge/mastering processing. Sum check is float PCM before PCM16 rounding. Large WAV are local artifacts, not tracked release files.

balanceMeasurement.method: Original-gain PCM16 WAV at climax beats 120–152, before LUFS mastering
balanceMeasurement.note: Energy measurements do not establish perceived musical balance.

note: Original musical development and arrangement. Changes were assessed from the score and objectively measured audio; no actual listening was performed. Measurements and automated checks do not establish musical quality.
